title: Cat and Mice
brief: Drag the cat to catch three bouncing mice while a dog chases the cat; catch all mice to win, get caught by the dog to lose.

title: Rocket Dodge
brief: Drag the rocket sideways to avoid falling asteroids; survive 25 seconds with a life left to win, lose all 3 lives to lose.

title: Paint the Square
brief: Three buttons recolour a square; tap the gold button 5 times to win, red and blue buttons cost points, and a 30 second timer ends the game.

title: Ball in the Hole
brief: Drag a ball to the hole at the top past a sliding bunker that resets it and a snake that ends the game.

title: Counter Race
brief: Tap a small button for +1 or a big button for +3 (it recharges for 2 seconds) and reach 20 before the rival counter does.

title: Dog Fetch
brief: Steer a dog with the joystick to fetch 6 bones that a crow keeps disturbing, before 40 seconds run out.

title: Swipe Flap
brief: Swipe up to flap a bird through two scrolling pipes under gravity; pass 5 pipes to win, touching a pipe or the border loses.

title: Swipe Slider
brief: Swipe to send a gem across a grid to the goal, avoiding a moving lava block and a still one.

title: Mole Tap
brief: Tap two moles that keep hopping to new spots for 8 points, avoid the stone that costs a point, and beat the 25 second clock.

title: Lamp Lighter
brief: Tap four lamps to light them while a bat flying over them puts lit lamps out; light all four before 40 seconds pass.

title: Fish Feeder
brief: Slide a fish left and right to eat 8 falling food pellets and dodge jellyfish; three stings lose.

title: Maze Mouse
brief: Steer a mouse with the joystick through a two-wall maze to the cheese while a cat chases; the cat catching the mouse loses.

title: Balloon Pop
brief: Tap rising balloons to pop 10 of them; three balloons escaping off the top lose.

title: Bee and Flowers
brief: Drag a bee onto two flowers that jump to new spots after each visit, collecting 6 nectar while avoiding a patrolling spider.

title: Defuse the Bomb
brief: A 5 second countdown ticks down; tap the blue wire to defuse it, the red or green wire or running out of time loses.

title: Duck Pond
brief: Lead three ducklings that follow the mother duck into the pond past a patrolling fox; all three in wins, the fox touching one loses.
